caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object against a plain, off-white background. The object has a two-pronged fork shape, with each prong being rounded at the tip. The surface of the object is textured, showing variations in brown hues to represent the grain and irregularities of the wood. There is a circular hole near the end opposite the prongs, likely for hanging or attaching the object. The edges of the object are worn and uneven, and the overall appearance is elongated with an organic, weathered look. There are no other items or decorative elements in the composition, and a small, faint signature is visible near the left side of the image.
